name: taskstore
description: Art's first-party work store — pure transition core + bindings; conforms to spec/taskstore-core and to felag-tasks (felag interchange)

loom.label: Tasks
loom.description: A work store: tasks, links, comments and the ready queue (spec/taskstore-core).

settings.name: TASKSTORE_DB
settings.label: Store file
settings.hint: the SQLite file the store lives in

settings.name: TASKSTORE_OWNER
settings.label: Whose call a task is
settings.hint: the person's slug; page comments are posted as them

settings.name: TASKSTORE_AGENTS
settings.label: Agents that may use the store over loom's API

settings.name: TASKSTORE_ON_OWNER_COMMENT
settings.label: When the owner comments from the page
settings.hint: a command as a JSON array, "{id}" for the task, e.g. a wake for the agent; the task also goes back to the first of TASKSTORE_AGENTS
